BILL NUMBER:  S3793

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the general business law, in relation to the manner of
the sale of airbags by motor vehicle dealers or manufacturers in
certain cases

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
The purpose of this bill is to require airbags to be sold without such
sale being tied into the sale of other goods and services.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Motor vehicle dealers and manufacturers who offer for sale and
installation an airbag, must offer such airbag as a standard feature
of that model of automobile or as an option, the purchase of which
does not require the purchase of other options, whether or not such
airbag is also offered as part of a package of options.

This section shall not apply to airbags required to be installed under
federal law.

A motor vehicle dealer shall not be in violation of this section if
the dealer, after due diligence, is unable to acquire from the
manufacturer a vehicle equipped with airbags as an option without the
purchase of a package of options.

 JUSTIFICATION :
It is in the best interest of consumers that they be able to purchase
safety features when purchasing a new motor vehicle.  Some motor
vehicle dealers offer airbags as an optional feature.  However,
airbags often can only be purchased within a package containing other
goods and services. This bill would require motor vehicle dealers and
manufacturers to offer as standard equipment or as an individual item,
the sale and installation of airbags without requiring the consumer to
purchase it as part of a package on new automobiles.

This bill would not prohibit offering for sale airbags as part of a
package, so long as the consumer is able to purchase airbags without
requiring the purchase of a package.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2007-2008: A.323-A - Third Reading Calendar No. 37
2005-2006: A.654 - Passed Assembly
2003-2004: A.11341-A - Passed Assembly

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the State.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect one hundred eighty days after it shall
become a law.

summary: Provides that airbags (not required by federal law) sold and installed by motor vehicle dealers or manufacturers must be offered as standard with the model or as stand alone options; provides for civil penalties for violations; further provides certain exemptions; authorizes attorney general enforcement.
title: Provides that airbags (not required by federal law) sold and installed by motor vehicle dealers or manufacturers must be offered as standard or as single options
